---
title: Fish Ravioli in Broth
id: MAR-0093
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 60
difficulty: medium
---
## Ingredients
- 200 g all-purpose flour
- 350 g hake fillet
- 100 g ricotta
- 1 l fish stock
- 1 egg
- to taste Salt and pepper
## Method
1. To prepare the pasta, arrange the flour with a pinch of salt in a well, pour 1 dl of water into the center and knead until you get a smooth and homogeneous mixture.
2. Cook the hake fillet steamed for 10 minutes, then chop it, collect it in a bowl, add the ricotta passed through a sieve, the egg, pepper and salt.
3. Mix the ingredients to combine them.
4. Roll out the pasta and with a small cutter cut out many discs of 4 cm diameter.
5. Place a teaspoon of filling on each pasta disc and close them into half moons pressing along the edges.
6. Cook the ravioli in the fish stock and serve them in deep plates.
